exploitation.response: HTTP 200 for all requests; bodies returned application homepage HTML (starts with "<!--\n  ~ Copyright (c) 2014-2026 Bjoern Kimminich & the OWASP Juice Shop contributors.")
exploitation.proof: No directory index content or file listing returned in any response; all responses returned the Juice Shop SPA HTML indicating route catch-all. No sensitive files were disclosed.

remediation: If directory listing is unwanted, ensure express.static/serve-index are configured with {index:false} or disable serve-index for sensitive directories. Serve a 403/404 for hidden files or restrict with authentication.
classificationReason: No evidence of exploitability after exhaustive testing
